title: Growth Marketing Engineer

Conversion rate optimization: Build and A/B test dedicated demo landing pages, landing pages, forms, and CTAs that turn visitors into meetings, including persona-aware routing (buyer vs. candidate vs. partner) across the site, and own the on-site demo path.

Marketing operations & RevOps: Own the full lead lifecycle and the automation behind it — CRM workflows, lifecycle-stage instrumentation, lead scoring and routing, and the visitor-signal-to-outbound engine across HubSpot, Amplemarket, RB2B, Duo, and Zapier. Email deliverability & infrastructure: Own outbound sending infrastructure — mailbox and domain strategy, warm-up and rotation, pre-send verification, and deliverability health — so outreach lands in the inbox and protects the primary domain’s reputation.

CRO instincts and conversion copywriting ability.

Bilingual Spanish/English, with fluent written English.
Experience in HR tech, workforce, background screening, or compliance-adjacent categories.
Account-based marketing (ABM) and audience segmentation.
Server-side, enhanced, or offline conversion tracking (e.g. CAPI).
Outbound email deliverability at scale — multi-domain/mailbox management, warm-up, and inbox placement.
Technical SEO and simple creative for ads and social.
Competitive salary (base range shared early in the process)
Major medical health insurance
Paid time off

About the job

About Turn




Turn is a venture-backed B2B software company built for the realities of high-volume hiring. We’re a small, fully remote team that moves quickly and ships real things.

title: Coordinadora de marketing digital
description:
About the job

HiperTexto Netizen, https://hipertexto.com.co 

 

CONVOCATORIA LABORAL EN MÉXICO

COORDINADORA DE MARKETING DIGITAL




La posición es responsable de la ejecución y el desempeño de los canales digitales de las librerías online Tinta y Sol (México) y Librería de la U (Colombia), cubriendo todo el embudo —alcance, consideración, conversión y fidelización— a través de pauta digital, contenido, e-commerce, canales B2B y relación con editoriales [CM1] y de marketplaces y actividades de marketing en la república mexicana. Se busca un perfil con capacidad de ejecutar estrategia, contenido visual y operación de forma simultánea, persona activa y con un amplio nivel de comunicación y relaciones públicas, con enfoque comercial.




Alcance regional: el foco prioritario es el crecimiento del mercado mexicano, donde la persona opera desde Ciudad de México. De forma complementaria, produce y adapta contenido, campañas y activaciones para la operación de Colombia, en coordinación con el equipo de Bogotá, aprovechando el catálogo y las alianzas editoriales compartidas entre ambos países.




 Salario:

 A convenir (según experiencia y competencias)

 Vinculación:

 Inmediata

 

2. Alcance de la responsabilidad

La estrategia de marketing, la identidad de marca y la aprobación de planes, presupuestos y piezas corresponden a la Dirección de Marketing. Dentro de ese marco, el cargo responde directamente por:

● El cumplimiento de las metas de venta, tráfico y conversión asignadas a los canales digitales bajo su gestión, con apertura por país.

● La entrega puntual del plan de medios, el calendario de activaciones y las piezas creativas para su aprobación, con la anticipación que defina la Dirección de Marketing.

● La ejecución fiel y oportuna de todo lo aprobado: que cada campaña, publicación y envío salga en la fecha, el canal y las condiciones acordadas.

● El desempeño diario de las campañas ya aprobadas: optimización de pujas, audiencias y distribución del presupuesto autorizado para maximizar el ROAS.

● La integridad operativa de los canales: exactitud de precios y fichas, disponibilidad publicada, reputación de vendedor en marketplaces y tiempos de respuesta al usuario[CM3] .

● El reporte de resultados en la periodicidad definida, incluyendo la explicación de las desviaciones y la propuesta de acciones correctivas.

Requieren aprobación previa de la Dirección de Marketing: la estrategia y el plan de medios, el monto y la reasignación del presupuesto de pauta, las piezas y copy antes de su publicación, los precios y descuentos promocionales, y cualquier acuerdo comercial con editoriales o aliados.




3. Funciones principales

Estrategia y pauta digital

● Proponer la estrategia de marketing 360º para los canales digitales bajo su gestión —con prioridad en México y participación en la operación de Colombia— y ejecutarla una vez aprobada.[CM4] 

● Planear, briefar y optimizar campañas de pauta en Meta Ads (Instagram / Facebook) y Google Ads dentro del presupuesto autorizado, con seguimiento de CPC, CPM, ROAS, CTR y CPA, gestionando cuentas y audiencias diferenciadas por país.

● Construir y someter a aprobación el calendario mensual de activaciones para ambos mercados, cruzando datos de venta, tráfico y tendencias culturales y editoriales, y respetando los calendarios propios de cada país (ferias, temporadas académicas y fechas comerciales).

Contenido y redes sociales

● Gestionar las redes sociales orgánicas —Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn y YouTube—: calendario, publicación y análisis de desempeño por canal y por país.

● Crear y editar contenido visual y gráfico (piezas de feed, stories, reels y banners) con ejecución directa, no únicamente brief a diseño.

● Producir contenido para la operación de Colombia y adaptar a México el contenido generado en Bogotá, cuidando la localización de tono, referencias culturales, moneda y disponibilidad de catálogo en cada país.

● Redactar copy y conceptos creativos con storytelling editorial.

● Gestionar el e-mail marketing: segmentación de bases, diseño HTML responsive y pruebas A/B de líneas de asunto.

E-commerce

● Administrar la experiencia de usuario e interfaz del e-commerce en Magento: fichas de producto, categorías, banners, navegación y checkout.

● Crear y publicar contenido directamente en los sitios de México y Colombia: novedades, destacados, promociones y páginas de campaña.

● Ejecutar SEO de producto, categoría y blog, con fundamentos de GEO/AEO (contenido optimizado para respuestas generadas por inteligencia artificial).

Marketplaces

● Gestionar los canales marketplaces de ambos países —MercadoLibre México y Colombia, Amazon y Buscalibre—: publicaciones, posicionamiento en búsqueda, precios y reputación de vendedor.

● Vigilar la consistencia de precio, disponibilidad y ficha entre los marketplaces y las tiendas propias de cada mercado.

Canal B2B y alianzas

● Gestionar estrategias de venta B2B dirigidas a instituciones académicas, bibliotecas, empresas y regalos corporativos, en México y Colombia.

● Administrar la relación con editoriales y clientes aliados, llevando las negociaciones de contenido promocional y condiciones comerciales conjuntas hasta su aprobación, y coordinando la ejecución de las campañas co–branded.

● Aprovechar las alianzas editoriales regionales para lanzar campañas simultáneas en los dos países cuando el catálogo y los derechos lo permitan.

WhatsApp y punto de venta

● Ejecutar campañas de fidelización y conversión vía WhatsApp: notificaciones, seguimiento y atención postventa.

● Apoyar los materiales , activaciones de punto de venta y apoyo en ferias del libro cuando aplique.[CM5] 

Analítica y conocimiento de mercado

● Cruzar datos de ventas (ERP e inventario), analítica web (GA4) y tendencias del mercado editorial para detectar oportunidades y anomalías, para México, debe ser coordinado con la Gerencia de Distribución Internacional.[CM6] 

● Conectar el catálogo con los momentos culturales relevantes de cada país, a partir de un conocimiento sólido de libros, autores, géneros y tendencias de lectura.

● Reportar los KPI de negocio con apertura por país: ventas, tráfico, conversión, CAC, ROAS, ticket promedio y open rate.

● Identificar qué campañas y aprendizajes de un mercado son replicables en el otro, y proponer su adaptación.




4. Perfil profesional requerido

Formación académica

Obligatorio: Licenciatura concluida en alguna de las siguientes áreas:

● Mercadotecnia o Marketing Digital

● Comunicación, Publicidad o Diseño de la Comunicación Gráfica

● Administración de Empresas o Negocios Internacionales

● Letras, Edición o carreras afines al sector editorial y cultural




Experiencia laboral

Mínimo 2 años —idealmente entre 2 y 4— de experiencia comprobable en:

● Marketing digital en e-commerce, retail o sector editorial y cultural.

● Gestión de pauta en Meta Ads y Google Ads con manejo directo de presupuesto.

● Administración de catálogo, categorías y fichas de producto.

● Gestión de marketplaces —MercadoLibre, Amazon, Buscalibre.

● Gestión de redes sociales orgánicas multicanal y creación de piezas listas para publicar.

● Deseable: haber trabajado con más de un mercado de Iberoamérica o con equipos distribuidos en distintos países.




5. Competencias y habilidades

Técnicas

● Pauta digital: Meta Ads y Google Ads

● Magento: administración de catálogo y contenido

● Google Analytics 4

● Herramientas de email marketing (Connectif, Klaviyo, Mailchimp o similares)

● Diseño y edición de contenido visual: Canva, Figma o Adobe (Photoshop / Illustrator)

● SEO de producto, categoría y blog; fundamentos de GEO/AEO

● Manejo de marketplaces y herramientas de gestión de publicaciones

Transversales

● Pensamiento analítico y estratégico, con decisiones basadas en datos cruzados

● Sensibilidad editorial y cultural, con capacidad de storytelling

● Autonomía en la ejecución y disciplina para trabajar dentro de lineamientos aprobados: perfil híbrido estratega, creativo y operativo

● Responsabilidad sobre resultados: capacidad de explicar desviaciones y proponer correctivos sin esperar a que se los pidan

● Habilidad de negociación y relacionamiento con editoriales y aliados comerciales

● Comunicación directa y orientación a resultados

● Gestión del tiempo y trabajo en equipo, con capacidad de operar dos mercados en paralelo sin perder foco en las prioridades de México

● Sensibilidad para leer las diferencias culturales y de consumo entre México y Colombia

● Interés genuino por los libros, los autores y las tendencias de lectura

 

6. Condiciones de trabajo

● Modalidad: Híbrido con mayor enfoque en Home Office

● Horario: Tiempo completo, con disponibilidad en horarios de oficina (GMT–6) y para reuniones con el equipo de Bogotá (GMT–5)

● Herramientas: Accesos y licencias provistos por la compañía. Equipo de cómputo portátil de su propiedad (Windows o Mac)

● Presupuesto: Ejecución del presupuesto de pauta aprobado por la Dirección de Marketing

● Comunicación: Reuniones virtuales periódicas con los equipos de México y Colombia

● Reporte: A la Dirección de Marketing, con metas e indicadores propios por mercado y revisión periódica de resultados

● Crecimiento: Capacitación continua y certificaciones en plataformas de pauta y analítica

● Ambiente: Equipo multicultural, proyectos de impacto regional en Iberoamérica




● Currículum Vitae actualizado

● Carta de presentación o motivación (máximo 1 página)

● Constancia de título profesional

● Portafolio de piezas gráficas, campañas y resultados de pauta (obligatorio)

● Referencias laborales (mínimo 2)

Interesadas favor enviar documentación al correo info@hipertexto.com.co con el asunto ”MX Coordinador de Marketing Digital” con copia a marketing.ucl@hipertexto.com.co

description:
About the job

Description

Amazon Mexico's Total Consumer Electronics is looking for a data driven, customer-obsessed, hands on and creative candidate to join our team. As a Brand Specialist, you'll own selected brands to help drive growth and help deliver a best-in-class customer experience on Amazon.com.mx, while facilitating great business relationships with some of Amazon's highest visibility brands.

Key job responsibilities

You'll be responsible for looking after the brands' portfolio, contributing to improvements in the experience for customers and creating weekly reports on performance. You'll lead presentations and planning sessions with vendors, acting as main point of contact for them.

You will provide support to drive business growth through detailed analysis of business inefficiencies and identifying solutions; proposing changes to operational processes; driving a high standard in customer satisfaction; ensuring high-quality product detail pages; and making recommendations for effective marketing campaigns.

To achieve success in this role, you will have strong analytical and relationship management skills. You are comfortable picking up new technologies and skills quickly. You'll be a problem solver, identifying issues or opportunity areas to then create plans to drive improvement.

As a Brand Specialist, You Will Be Fully Involved In All Business Functions Of Your Brands, Including Onsite Marketing, Vendor Relation Management And In-stock Management. Some Of The Tasks Associated With These Functions Include

Online marketing: improve product page data, develop marketing and merchandising plans, improve experience onsite, generate traffic and sales; Vendor management: grow catalog to sell on Amazon, identify and resolve pricing issues; In-stock management: tracking purchase orders and work with vendors automation.

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 1+ years of account management, project or program management or buying experience
 Experience using analytical specific tools such as Google Analytics, SQL or HTML
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience in process improvement
 Experience managing large amounts of data

description:
About the job

Responsibilities

About the Team

The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the commerce channel of choice for merchants, creators, and affiliates.

You've seen the virality and impact of #TikTokMadeMeBuyIt. Come join the team that is helping scale that phenomenon, and pioneer Content & Creator commerce in the LATAM. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the leading, on-trend commerce platform of choice for brands, creators, and shoppers. We are an entrepreneurial team, passionate about shaping the future of shopping.

The TikTok Shop LATAM operation team aims to deliver high quality products together with a unique customer experience via TikTok. The team is responsible for building the TikTok e-Commerce partnership for the TikTok e-commerce business in the US. With more than 1 billion loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join us to build an e-Commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users together.

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

Successful candidates must be able to commit to at least 6 months long internship period.

Responsibilities:

Seller Growth & Engagement


 Support the execution of seller growth programs such as webinars, educational sessions, and platform campaigns while assisting Category and Operations teams in promoting key initiatives including campaigns, LIVE activities, and promotional events.
 Help drive seller participation in platform programs, campaigns, and content initiatives and monitor seller feedback to help identify opportunities to improve engagement.


Content & Communication


 Support the creation and coordination of seller-facing communications across email, social channels, webinars, and community groups to help ensure communications are clear, accurate, and aligned with platform guidelines.
 Coordinate with internal teams to gather information and assets for seller communications, and assist in maintaining communication calendars and campaign materials organized and updated


Campaign & Project Management


 Support cross-functional seller marketing projects by coordinating with teams such as Content, LIVE, Product, Legal, and Operations.
 Track timelines, deliverables, and follow-ups to help ensure smooth execution and assist with campaign setup, reporting, and operational tasks.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


 Applicants are kindly requested to submit an English-language resume
 Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or Communications
 Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
 Strong communication and collaboration skills.
 Strong interest in e-commerce, creator economy, digital marketing, and marketplace platforms.
 Analytical mindset with basic knowledge of data analysis and reporting.


Preferred Qualification


 Previous internship or extracurricular experience in marketing, e-commerce, digital content, operations, or project coordination is a plus.


By submitting an application for this role, you accept and agree to our global applicant privacy policy, which may be accessed here: https://careers.tiktok.com/legal/privacy

Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok Accommodation

description:
About the job

Descripción General

Are you someone who is passionate, motivated, and driven to make a difference? If so, MSA Safety is the perfect fit for your career.

At MSA, SAFETY is who we are AND it is what we do. We are a purpose-driven company committed to deploying innovation and technology to deliver on our Mission to help protect people and assets all around the world. We continue to be relentless in our pursuit of solving our customers greatest problems so they can go home safe each and every day.

Are you in? Read on for more details about this particular role.

Responsabilidades

The Segment Marketing Manager for Growth will be responsible for defining and executing the go-to-market strategy for their segments of responsibility, focusing on demand generation initiatives and marketing strategies that seamlessly integrate local market needs with the company's global strategy. This role requires a deep understanding of customer personas, the complete buying process, and key customer pain points to deliver powerful and differentiated selling propositions to the sales team.

Key Responsibilities:


Execute and Optimize Commercial Initiatives – Manage existing commercial initiatives to drive demand for the product and market, ensuring alignment with sales team objectives and market dynamics.
Measure and Adjust Strategy Performance – Measure the success of strategy implementation through KPIs and adjust tactics as needed to ensure alignment with the company's strategic objectives.
Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with Marketing peers, Marcom, Sales, Customer service, service and operations teams to ensure marketing activities are aligned with market needs and contribute to the overall effectiveness of market strategies.
Feed Market Intelligence to Global Strategy – Feed local major customer needs, product requirements, and market dynamics to the rest of the strategic product marketing organization for incorporation into the global strategy.



Requisitos

Experience (required):


 5+ years of business experience, with 3 years in experience marketing or customer-facing roles;
 Deep knowledge in products strategy, industry standards, and safety regulations;
 Analytical profile with strong business mindset;
 Technical sales process and/or customer facing role experience;
 Language: Spanish, Portuguese and English spoken and written (Proficiency)
 Work experience interacting with customers, sales and distributors.
 Demonstrated experience in demand generation and go-to-market strategy execution



Experience (preferred):


 MS Office management and ERP systems;
 Excel proficiency and SAP ECC experience;
 Account-Based Marketing (ABM) or Account-Based Acceleration (ABA) experience;
 Experience with marketing automation platforms and CRM systems (Salesforce);
 Background in strategic planning and value proposition development;

 Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business administration and/or Engineering.
 Project management, strategic planning, value proposition management

title: Senior CRM & Salesforce Marketing Cloud Strategy Lead

Definir modelos de segmentación, reglas de contacto, gobierno de audiencias, criterios de supresión, consentimiento, preferencia, frecuencia y personalización.
Colaborar con equipos de negocio, data, tecnología, creatividad, medios y operaciones para asegurar una implementación end-to-end eficiente, escalable y gobernada.

Trabajar de forma activa con equipos de medios para conectar audiencias CRM y first-party data con plataformas de activación pagada como Google DV360, Meta u otras plataformas de paid media, asegurando una visión integrada entre canales propios y medios pagados.

Establecer frameworks de medición que conecten métricas operativas como aperturas, clicks, bounces y entregabilidad con métricas de negocio como conversión, revenue, retención, CLV, cross-sell, up-sell y churn.

Documentar procesos, mejores prácticas, modelos operativos, RACI, SLAs, lineamientos de uso y criterios de gobierno de Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
Más de 8 años de experiencia en CRM, marketing automation, marketing directo, customer engagement, MarTech o disciplinas relacionadas.

Experiencia comprobable en Salesforce Marketing Cloud, idealmente en roles como Marketing Cloud Consultant, CRM Manager, Marketing Automation Manager, CRM Strategist, CRM Project Manager o Salesforce Marketing Cloud Lead.
Experiencia práctica en implementación de campañas, journeys, automatizaciones, segmentaciones, data extensions, QA, reporting y operación de campañas de alto volumen.
Experiencia evolucionando desde una posición operativa o técnica hacia un rol estratégico, consultivo y orientado a negocio.
Conocimiento de modelos de datos, integración entre plataformas, Customer 360, Data Cloud, Sales/Service Cloud Connect, CDP o integraciones con plataformas externas será altamente valorado.

Experiencia trabajando con audiencias CRM conectadas a medios pagados, incluyendo coordinación con equipos de medios, definición de segmentos accionables y activación en plataformas como Google DV360, Meta u otras DSPs.
Experiencia en campañas de alto volumen, múltiples unidades de negocio, alta complejidad operativa, clientes regionales o entornos multi-agencia.
Capacidad para liderar conversaciones con stakeholders técnicos, comerciales, de marketing, data, tecnología y medios, desde equipos operativos hasta dirección.

Conocimiento funcional de SQL para segmentación, manejo de audiencias y extracción de data views.
Entendimiento de HTML/CSS para campañas de email, QA de piezas y personalización dinámica.
Conocimiento de entregabilidad: calentamiento de IPs, reputación de dominio, bounces, spam complaints, frequency capping y reglas de contacto.
Familiaridad con dashboards, reporting, atribución, análisis de performance y optimización de campañas.
Deseable experiencia con Adobe Campaign/AJO, HubSpot, Treasure Data, Databricks, Google Analytics, Power BI o herramientas de BI/medición.

Dominio operativo de CRM con visión de negocio.
Capacidad para conectar tecnología, datos, creatividad, medios y objetivos comerciales.
Conocimiento funcional de paid media, audiencias, first-party data y activación omnicanal.
Comunicación ejecutiva y storytelling con datos.
Gestión de stakeholders y liderazgo transversal.
Orientación a resultados, optimización continua y mejora de procesos.
Alta organización, ownership, criterio técnico y atención al detalle.
Capacidad para trabajar en entornos ágiles, multi-equipo y con alta presión operativa.
description:

La posición será responsable de liderar la estrategia, evolución e implementación avanzada de iniciativas CRM sobre Salesforce Marketing Cloud, asegurando que los datos, audiencias, automatizaciones, journeys y canales directos se traduzcan en experiencias personalizadas, medibles y alineadas a objetivos de negocio. El rol requiere una base técnica sólida en implementación y operación de campañas, combinada con una visión consultiva y estratégica para definir roadmaps, modelos operativos, casos de uso, frameworks de medición y oportunidades de optimización continua.




Responsabilidades clave

Definir la estrategia CRM y el roadmap de evolución de Salesforce Marketing Cloud, alineado a prioridades de negocio, marketing, ventas, retención, lealtad y crecimiento.

description:
About the job

About the Team

The Consumer Performance Marketing team owns the execution of paid social acquisition across Meta, TikTok, and Snapchat. We operate at scale across the U.S. and Canada, managing complex builds, pacing routines, live optimizations, QA workflows, and experiment cycles that directly impact consumer growth.

We work closely with U.S.-based Channel Managers, Creative, Analytics, and Martech, functioning as one integrated performance engine. This requires strong operational discipline, fast signal interpretation, and a mindset focused on translating platform behavior into clear, actionable steps.

While the team is execution-heavy, we also influence strategy by shaping testing agendas, surfacing insights, and partnering with platform reps on betas and new product rollouts. It's a high-ownership environment for operators who thrive in fast, data-driven systems.

About the Role

This role owns the tactical execution of Consumer paid social campaigns end-to-end. You will build, QA, pace, optimize, and iterate campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Snap, managing multi-million-dollar budgets with precision.

You'll partner with U.S. teams and platform reps to run experiments, test new bidding approaches, evaluate audience structures, and support creative testing. You will also be expected to diagnose issues quickly, communicate insights clearly, and maintain structurally sound accounts.

This position requires someone who can execute with technical depth, think analytically, and move fast — ensuring each optimization ties directly to performance outcomes.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Be a part of our first DoorDash team in our Mexico City office! 
Manage multi-million dollar monthly digital budgets across digital paid marketing channels, working with partners such as Meta, Snap, Google and TikTok to optimize campaign performance and test new products.
Learn to operate a world-class acquisition program that brings in millions of orders to DoorDash, making it the top food delivery and logistics platform in the U.S.. working with our U.S. based
Maintain and monitor key metrics across channels including budget pacing, cost per acquisition and LTV proxies.
Manage an experimentation roadmap to optimize performance including A/B creative tests, incrementality tests, and bidding algo tests
Work closely with other teams and stakeholders to ensure goals are met


We're excited about you because…


You are proficient in the English language 
You have a proven track record in the performance marketing space, with 4+ years of experience.
Direct, hands-on experience managing media buying, optimization (Paid Social), and strategic planning either at an agency or in-house
You are highly proficient in Excel/Google Sheets and have deep familiarity with metrics such as CPA, CPC, CVR, and LTV.
Strong quantitative, analytical and problem-solving skills; must be very comfortable with data analysis and able to use data to make decisions and conduct experiments.
Experience with Web & App Tracking/Attribution (preferred)
Knowledge of SQL (preferred)
Experience working on multi-sided marketplace businesses (preferred)

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. About Spotlight Media

Spotlight Media is a leading TikTok Shop Partner agency, scaling some of the most recognizable brands in the new age of social commerce. Unlike traditional agencies, we don’t believe in cookie-cutter playbooks- every strategy we craft is custom-built to unlock our clients’ full potential on TikTok Shop. As a TikTok Shop–only agency, our entire focus, from the initiatives we pursue to the talent we hire, is singularly dedicated to driving growth on the platform.

We’ve guided brands through the full funnel- from launch to scaling into the millions in GMV-and we’re just getting started.

We believe the future of e-commerce is social. That’s why we’re building a team of high-agency individuals who thrive on ownership, autonomy, and speed. Spotlight is not just a place to execute campaigns-it’s a blank canvas where ambitious people can build real leverage, take on increasing responsibility, and grow into senior operators quickly. Our culture is high-performing, entrepreneurial, and unapologetically ambitious.

Join us, and you’ll have the trust, resources, and runway to redefine what’s possible for the world’s leading brands.

The Role

We are hiring a Creator Campaign Coordinator to support the execution of paid creator campaigns across our portfolio of TikTok Shop brands. Working closely with our US-based Creator Management team, you will coordinate the day-to-day operations of creator partnerships throughout the full campaign lifecycle — from identifying and engaging creators through contracting, onboarding, content delivery, and campaign close-out.

This role is central to how our campaigns run: brands entrust us with significant budgets each month, and the coordinator's work ensures every campaign is fully staffed, every creator is supported, and every deliverable is completed on schedule. It is a high-volume, detail-driven position best suited to someone who has managed paid creator collaborations professionally and enjoys being the person who keeps everything moving.

We are specifically looking for candidates with prior experience at an influencer marketing, UGC, creator management, or talent agency, where they personally coordinated paid creator partnerships end to end.

Key Responsibilities


Identify and evaluate creators for paid campaigns based on brand fit, content quality, and campaign requirements
Manage creator outreach and follow-up communications across email, SMS, and social channels until each campaign is fully staffed
Administer creator agreements and onboarding, including contract delivery, signature collection, and documentation
Coordinate product logistics with participating creators and confirm receipt ahead of production timelines
Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for creators during active campaigns, providing timely, professional support
Track contracted deliverables from kickoff through final posting, proactively following up to keep campaigns on schedule
Support creator payment workflows, ensuring documentation is accurate and submitted on time
Maintain accurate, up-to-date campaign records and provide regular status reporting to the Creator Management team


Qualifications


2+ years of experience at an influencer marketing, UGC, creator management, or talent agency, with direct, hands-on responsibility for paid creator collaborations
Demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of concurrent creator partnerships without losing track of details or timelines
Excellent written and verbal English (C1 or above); all creator and internal communication is conducted in English

A professional, relationship-oriented communication style — able to hold creators to deadlines and quality standards while maintaining strong working relationships
Proficiency with spreadsheets, project trackers, and CRM or creator-management platforms

title: COORDINADOR DE PLANEACIÓN Y SUPPLY CHAIN
description:
About the job

COORDINADOR DE PLANEACIÓN Y SUPPLY CHAIN

INGENIERO INDUSTRIAL O AFIN 

Ubicación: Monterrey, Nuevo León

Empresa: MUTUO Maquila de Ropa Deportiva

Modalidad: Presencial

Experiencia: 5 a 8 años

Sueldo: $35,000 a $40,000 brutos mensuales + prestaciones

OBJETIVO DEL PUESTO

Buscamos un Ingeniero Industrial o afín, altamente estructurado, analítico y orientado a procesos, para coordinar la planeación de demanda, materiales, abastecimiento, inventarios y logística de una empresa manufacturera en crecimiento.

Esta posición tendrá un papel clave en la profesionalización de la operación.

Buscamos una persona que tenga capacidad para analizar, anticiparse, ordenar información, crear controles y desarrollar procesos sólidos que permitan crecer la empresa con mayor control y que sea altamente opertiva también.

Trabajará directamente con Dirección, Producción y diversas maquilas a nivel nacional.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALESPLANEACIÓN DE DEMANDA Y PRODUCCIÓN

· Consolidar pedidos confirmados y proyectos próximos.

· Mantener actualizado el plan de demanda.

· Traducir pedidos de clientes en necesidades de materiales y fechas.

· Dar visibilidad de la carga de trabajo de las siguientes semanas.

· Identificar anticipadamente riesgos de faltantes o retrasos.

· Coordinarse con Producción para validar capacidad y fechas compromiso.

· Dar seguimiento semanal al cumplimiento del plan.

· Desarrollar gradualmente mejores herramientas de forecast y planeación.

PLANEACIÓN DE MATERIALES

· Determinar requerimientos de telas, avíos, empaques y demás materiales necesarios para producción.

· Validar existencias antes de generar compras.

· Considerar inventarios, consumos, lead times y fechas de producción.

· Generar alertas anticipadas de materiales críticos.

· Reducir compras urgentes y faltantes que detengan producción.

· Apoyar en la construcción de mínimos, máximos y puntos de reorden.

COMPRAS Y ABASTECIMIENTO

· Generar y dar seguimiento a órdenes de compra.

· Solicitar y comparar cotizaciones.

· Negociar condiciones básicas con proveedores.

· Confirmar fechas compromiso.

· Dar seguimiento hasta la recepción completa del material.

· Mantener actualizada la información de proveedores, precios y tiempos de entrega.

· Buscar nuevas alternativas de suministro cuando sea necesario.

· Evaluar cumplimiento de proveedores.

INVENTARIOS

· Mejorar la exactitud de inventarios.

· Coordinar entradas y salidas de materiales.

· Implementar conteos cíclicos.

· Identificar faltantes, diferencias, sobreinventarios y materiales de lento movimiento.

· Desarrollar controles sencillos de cobertura y rotación.

LOGÍSTICA

· Coordinar recolecciones y entregas.

· Dar seguimiento a transportistas.

· Coordinar movimientos de mercancía entre proveedores, planta, maquilas externas y clientes.

· Llevar control de fechas compromiso.

· Analizar incidencias y retrasos.

· Buscar mejoras en rutas, tiempos y costos.

· Mantener visibilidad del estatus de cada entrega.

PROCESOS Y SISTEMAS

Una parte importante del puesto será ayudar a transformar actividades actualmente manuales en procesos más estructurados.

Esperamos que la persona pueda:

· Documentar procesos.

· Crear formatos y controles.

· Construir indicadores.

· Mejorar bases de datos.

· Automatizar reportes.

· Identificar información que actualmente no se está controlando.

· Participar en la implementación y mejora del ERP.

· Ayudar a establecer responsables y flujos de trabajo.

· Utilizar Excel y herramientas digitales para mejorar la toma de decisiones.

No esperamos que la persona llegue con todas las respuestas ni que implemente por sí sola un sistema corporativo complejo.

Sí esperamos que tenga la capacidad de decir:

“Esto actualmente se controla así; propongo ordenarlo de esta manera y medirlo con estos indicadores.”

· Pedidos entregados a tiempo.

· Materiales disponibles a tiempo para producción.

· Número de faltantes.

· Compras urgentes.

· Cumplimiento de proveedores.

· Exactitud de inventario.

· Órdenes de compra vencidas.

· Entregas logísticas a tiempo.

Experiencia

· Planeación de demanda.

· Inventarios.

Será especialmente valorada experiencia en empresas con múltiples SKUs, producción contra pedido y operaciones de manufactura.

Herramientas

PERFIL PERSONAL

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
About the job

About Alibaba.com

Alibaba.com is one of the world’s leading B2B e-commerce platforms, connecting businesses around the globe and helping small and medium-sized enterprises grow through digital trade.

We are expanding our sales team in Mexico City and looking for ambitious, resilient, and results-driven sales professionals to help grow our business across the Americas, with a strong focus on the United States.




About the Role

As a Bilingual Outbound Sales Development Representative, you will be responsible for identifying and contacting potential business customers, qualifying their needs, and booking demos for our US-based sales team.

This is a high-volume outbound calling role. You will spend most of your day calling business owners and decision-makers, introducing Alibaba.com, qualifying interest, and creating qualified sales opportunities.

This role is ideal for someone who is energized by phone-based sales, comfortable with rejection, and motivated by daily activity targets, pipeline creation, and performance-based results.




What You Will Do

• Make high-volume outbound calls to potential business customers, primarily in the US market.

• Contact business owners and decision-makers to introduce Alibaba.com and identify potential sellers.

• Qualify leads based on business needs, interest level, and fit for Alibaba.com membership.

• Book qualified demos and meetings for the US sales closing team.

• Follow up consistently through phone, email, and other approved outreach channels.

• Maintain accurate records of calls, conversations, lead status, and next steps.

• Work closely with the sales team to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and demo show-up rates.

• Meet or exceed daily, weekly, and monthly targets for outbound activity, qualified leads, and booked demos.




What We Are Looking For

• Previous experience in outbound sales, cold calling, telemarketing, appointment setting, lead generation, business development, or call center sales.

• Strong comfort with making a high volume of outbound calls every day.

• English proficiency at B2 level or above; C1 preferred.

• Ability to speak professionally and confidently with US-based business owners and decision-makers.

• Resilient, persistent, and motivated by targets and performance metrics.

• Strong listening skills and ability to quickly identify customer needs.

• Organized and disciplined in tracking follow-ups and sales activity.

• Experience selling to SMBs, merchants, manufacturers, exporters, distributors, or business owners is a plus.

• Interest in e-commerce, international trade, or digital business is a plus.







What Success Looks Like

• You consistently complete daily outbound call targets.

• You generate qualified leads and book demos for the US sales team.

• Your booked demos have strong show-up and conversion quality.

• You are comfortable hearing “no” often and continuing with energy and professionalism.

• You improve your pitch, objection handling, and qualification skills over time.




Why Join Us

• Build international B2B sales experience with customers across the Americas.

• Work with Alibaba.com, a globally recognized B2B e-commerce platform.

• Develop outbound sales, lead generation, and business development skills.

• Join a growing Mexico City team supporting expansion in the US market.

• Be part of a performance-driven environment where results and ownership are recognized.

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly operational, proactive, and detail-oriented Marketing Analyst to execute digital marketing activities in Brazil with discipline and consistency. This is primarily an execution role: publishing, updating, responding, coordinating, and reporting — reliably and on time.

The role supports B2B demand generation campaigns and marketing materials for the distribution channel (dealers), and supervises campaign execution carried out by the external digital agency.




Key Responsibilities

Execution & Deliverables

-Own and deliver the monthly content calendar for Brazil (social media, email/mailing campaigns, and web content), on time, every month.

-Execute social media campaigns and email marketing campaigns end to end: briefing, scheduling, publishing, and reporting.

-Support B2B demand generation campaigns and produce or coordinate marketing materials for the distribution channel (dealers).




Agency & Campaign Supervision

-Supervise and support paid media campaigns (SEM, paid social) executed by the external agency: review briefs, validate setup, monitor pacing and performance, and flag issues early.

-Act as the day-to-day operational contact for the agency, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are met.




Social Media

-Monitor and respond to social media messages and inquiries within one business day.

-Manage social media publishing and community management according to the approved content calendar.

-Track social media performance and prepare a monthly report.




SEO & Content

-Research and write SEO-optimized content in Portuguese for websites, blogs, and landing pages.

-Coordinate content reviews and approvals with the Brazil Marketing Manager before publication.

-Conduct keyword research and support on-page SEO optimization.




Website & CMS Management

-Update website content using the company's Content Management System (CMS).

-Ensure website pages are accurate, up to date, and optimized for user experience and search engines.

-Coordinate with internal stakeholders to publish new content and landing pages.




CRM & Marketing Operations

-Maintain and update customer data within the CRM (HubSpot).

-Support email marketing campaigns, lead management, and customer segmentation.

Maintain marketing automation workflows and campaign tracking.




Reporting

-Prepare recurring marketing reports and dashboards (monthly at minimum) covering SEO, website traffic, social media, email, and campaign performance.

-Keep task and project status updated in the team’s work management tool (ClickUp) without needing reminders.




Working Style Expectations

This role requires a specific way of working. Candidates should recognize themselves in the following:

-Proactive: anticipates needs, raises blockers early, and proposes next steps instead of waiting for instructions.

-Diligent and consistent: deliverables are completed on time, every time, without follow-up or reminders.

-Responsive: replies to internal messages and social media inquiries quickly (same business day).

-Punctual: meets deadlines and arrives prepared to meetings.

-Sound judgment: knows when to act, when to ask, and when to escalate — especially across time zones with a regional manager.




Qualifications

-Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

2–4 years of experience in digital marketing or a similar hands-on role.

-Native Portuguese speaker (role is based in Brazil).

-Advanced English (written and spoken) — required for daily coordination with the regional team.

-Experience managing social media platforms and community engagement.

-Solid understanding of SEO principles, keyword research, and on-page optimization.

-Familiarity with SEM concepts and performance monitoring (agency supervision, not hands-on execution).

-Experience using CRM and marketing automation platforms (HubSpot preferred).

-Experience with work management tools (ClickUp preferred, or Asana, Monday, Trello).

-Experience updating websites through a CMS (e.g., WordPress, Drupal, Sitecore, or similar).

-Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and marketing reporting.

-Familiarity with Google Analytics and Google Search Console is preferred.

title: International Sales Representative
description:
About the job

Acerca de WIN SOURCE




WIN SOURCE – Donde comienza el suministro

Fundada en 1999, WIN SOURCE ayuda a los fabricantes a asegurar componentes electrónicos críticos y a construir cadenas de suministro más resilientes en un mercado global cada vez más complejo , con el apoyo de un equipo global de más de 450 empleados.




A través de NEXUS™, nuestra plataforma inteligente para la cadena de suministro, y nuestra red mundial de capacidades de abastecimiento, inventario y logística, ayudamos a los clientes a tomar decisiones de abastecimiento más inteligentes, fortalecer la continuidad del suministro y responder con confianza a los desafíos cambiantes del mercado.




En la actualidad, WIN SOURCE presta servicios a clientes de todo el mundo a través de operaciones estratégicamente ubicadas en Asia, Europa y Norteamérica, instalaciones certificadas y un firme compromiso con la calidad, la fiabilidad y la excelencia operativa.




Acerca del puesto

El puesto de Representante de Ventas Internacionales en WIN SOURCE está diseñado para profesionales de ventas que desean desarrollar una carrera a largo plazo en el desarrollo de negocios B2B globales y soluciones para la cadena de suministro de componentes electrónicos.




En este puesto, te centrarás en el desarrollo de clientes, el apoyo en solicitudes de cotización y presupuestos, el seguimiento de oportunidades y la comunicación con los clientes, ayudándoles a abordar la disponibilidad de componentes, la presión de los plazos de entrega, las transiciones del ciclo de vida y otros desafíos de la cadena de suministro. Esta posición va más allá de la venta de productos; te ayuda a comprender las necesidades de adquisición y cadena de suministro de los clientes y a generar valor a través de las capacidades globales de abastecimiento y suministro de WIN SOURCE.




Trabajando en estrecha colaboración con los equipos de ventas, aprovisionamiento, logística y calidad de WIN SOURCE, irás adquiriendo gradualmente experiencia práctica en el desarrollo de clientes internacionales, mercados de componentes electrónicos y soluciones para la continuidad del suministro.




Responsabilidades clave

●Desarrollar y mantener relaciones con clientes nuevos y existentes en los mercados asignados.

●Identificar posibles oportunidades de negocio mediante estudios de mercado, desarrollo de clientes, plataformas del sector y un seguimiento constante.

●Brindar soporte durante todo el proceso de ventas, incluyendo la comunicación con el cliente, la gestión de solicitudes de cotización, la preparación de presupuestos, el seguimiento de pedidos y la coordinación de entregas.

●Colaborar con los equipos internos de abastecimiento, logística y calidad para ayudar a los clientes a abordar la escasez de productos, las transiciones del ciclo de vida, los riesgos de fin de vida útil, la presión de los plazos de entrega y los desafíos de costos.

●Mantener información precisa sobre los clientes, actualizaciones de oportunidades, registros de cotizaciones y datos de CRM para respaldar el desarrollo de clientes a largo plazo.

●Desarrollar continuamente el conocimiento del producto, la conciencia del mercado y las habilidades de comunicación con el cliente para fortalecer la capacidad de ventas en la industria de componentes electrónicos.

●Brindar apoyo en reuniones con clientes, actividades de marketing y ferias internacionales según sea necesario.




¿Por qué unirse a WIN SOURCE?

En WIN SOURCE, tu trabajo crea valor más allá de las transacciones individuales. Tendrás la oportunidad de:

●Desarrolla o impulsa tu carrera en ventas internacionales en el centro de la cadena de suministro global de componentes electrónicos.

●Descubra cómo las empresas manufactureras abordan las decisiones de adquisición y abastecimiento, y cómo se resuelven los verdaderos desafíos de la cadena de suministro más allá de las ventas transaccionales.

●Adquiera experiencia en mercados de electrónica avanzada como el industrial, el automotriz, el médico, la infraestructura de IA y otros sectores de rápido crecimiento.

●Aproveche la red global de abastecimiento de WIN SOURCE, su experiencia en el mercado y el apoyo de equipos multifuncionales para ofrecer soluciones que van más allá de la distribución tradicional.

●Siga una trayectoria profesional clara, desde la ejecución de ventas hasta la gestión de cuentas, el desarrollo del mercado regional y funciones de gestión comercial más amplias.




Lo que buscamos

●1-2 años de experiencia en ventas B2B, gestión de cuentas, desarrollo de negocio o funciones comerciales afines, con una capacidad demostrada para desarrollar clientes e impulsar el crecimiento del negocio.

●Se valora mucho la experiencia en componentes electrónicos, semiconductores, distribución de productos electrónicos, servicios de fabricación electrónica (EMS) o cadenas de suministro de fabricación.

●Sólidas habilidades de comunicación, negociación y para establecer relaciones, con capacidad para comprender las necesidades del cliente y ofrecer soluciones que aporten valor.

●Mentalidad orientada al cliente, con una sólida visión comercial y capacidad para gestionar oportunidades a lo largo de todo el ciclo de ventas.

●Pasión por las ventas internacionales y el desarrollo de negocios, con una mentalidad proactiva, un fuerte sentido de la responsabilidad y el impulso para crear valor a largo plazo en un entorno global.




Beneficios y desarrollo profesional

En WIN SOURCE, apoyamos a las personas que desean aprender, crecer y generar valor en los negocios internacionales.




Ofrecemos:

●Salario base competitivo con incentivos basados en el rendimiento, lo que brinda a los profesionales de ventas motivados la oportunidad de aumentar su potencial de ingresos.

●Formación sistemática en ventas, desarrollo del conocimiento del producto y experiencia práctica en los mercados globales de electrónica.

●Oportunidades para colaborar con clientes internacionales, cuentas estratégicas y equipos internos experimentados.

●La oportunidad de ayudar a resolver problemas reales de los clientes relacionados con el suministro de componentes, la continuidad del suministro y el crecimiento del negocio.

●Oportunidades para participar en exposiciones internacionales, reuniones con clientes y actividades comerciales globales según sea necesario.

●Un entorno de trabajo multicultural y colaborativo con equipos repartidos por Asia, Europa y Norteamérica.

●Trayectoria profesional: Representante de ventas → Especialista en ventas / Supervisor de ventas → Gerente de ventas → Gerente regional de ventas → Gestión global de ventas




Únete a WIN SOURCE

¿Estás listo para impulsar tu carrera en ventas internacionales y marcar la diferencia en la cadena de suministro global de electrónica?




Postúlate hoy mismo y únete a WIN SOURCE: donde comienza el suministro.

Envía tu solicitud a través de LinkedIn o remite tu currículum a:

careers@win-source.net




Sigue a WIN SOURCE en LinkedIn para conocer las últimas novedades de la empresa, información relevante del sector y oportunidades laborales.

description:
About the job

Objetivo Principal del Puesto Gestionar, desarrollar y negociar comercialmente la relación con cadenas de autoservicio, asegurando el cumplimiento de las metas de ventas de entrada y salida (sell-in y sell-out), la rentabilidad de las cuentas, el correcto abasto de producto y la óptima ejecución en el punto de venta.




Funciones y Responsabilidades Principales Gestion comercial de cuentas: Desarrollar y mantener relaciones comerciales estratégicas con los compradores de cadenas de autoservicio y formato club. Presentar propuestas comerciales, catalogación o alta de nuevos productos y coordinar acuerdos de exhibición.




Planeación y proyección (Forecast): Elaborar y dar seguimiento al forecast de ventas de forma mensual, trimestral y anual. Monitorear y analizar indicadores clave de desempeño: sell-in, sell-out, días de inventarios (DOS), faltantes en anaquel (out of stock) y margen de rentabilidad.

Negociación y promociones: Planear y coordinar el calendario promocional en conjunto con las áreas de Trade Marketing y Finanzas. Negociar espacios adicionales, cabeceras, islas y correcta visibilidad en el anaquel.

Operación administrativa de cuentas: Administrar los portales de proveedores de autoservicio para la consulta de pedidos, facturación e inventarios. Dar seguimiento al flujo de pedidos, conciliaciones, cobranza, aclaración de deducciones y devoluciones.




Coordinación interdepartamental: Trabajar de la mano con las áreas de Logística para asegurar entregas a tiempo y completas (OTIF), Trade Marketing para la ejecución en tienda y Finanzas para la gestión de precios y márgenes.




Perfil del Candidato Educación: Licenciatura concluida en Administración, Mercadotecnia, Negocios Internacionales, Relaciones Comerciales o carrera afín. Experiencia laboral: De 2 a 4 años gestionando cuentas clave en el canal autoservicio o retail. Experiencia previa directa negociando con compradores del sector. Conocimientos técnicos: Manejo avanzado de Excel y herramientas de presentación ejecutivo, análisis de métricas de retail (sell-in, sell-out, rotación) y uso de portales de proveedores.




Competencias y Habilidades Negociación estratégica y manejo de objeciones. Capacidad analítica y pensamiento orientado a datos. Orientación a resultados y visión de negocio. Habilidades de comunicación y relacionamiento interpersonal. Resolución de problemas y trabajo bajo presión.

description:
About the job

Who We Are

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About The Role

Being customer obsessed and data driven is what drives this role. We’re looking for individuals who can empathize with users, and work towards making their everyday lives easier. If you’re analytical, detail-oriented, and organized, but also excited to roll up your sleeves and get your hands dirty, you’d fit right in. The role will require rotational working hours to ensure smooth operational running of the 24/7/365 real-time set up, and collaboration with a global team. This role directly powers a critical live customer-facing product safety product, which forms the foundation for multiple other safety features. You would be the expert at risk identification, for all our customers using our safety products. You would also work closely with the Research & Development teams, to power our in-house Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence models, by generating high quality training datasets. This requires an understanding of data requirements, data definitions, edge-cases, tooling and review processes. In addition to that, you would also work closely with the Product team to run proof of concepts and experiments, which guide the direction of our Safety product suite, particularly in the areas of risk identification, mitigation, and reduction. You would also contribute toward analyzing data to improve the user experience for our customers. You’ll work a regular five‑day schedule, including day, evening and/or overnight and weekend shifts as part of a rotation. Overnight (11pm - 7am for example) shifts include enhanced compensation where applicable.

What You'll Do


Review and analyze live videos captured by Motive's dashcam for risk identification, based on the known risk factors combined with the contextual knowledge which would vary from case to case.
Adhere to the established guidelines and protocols for annotation to ensure consistency and reliability of data.
Ensure timely delivery of accurate data as per SLAs.
Consistently strive to enhance the annotation procedures and play a role in shaping the team's best practices through active participation.
Exhibit flexibility and adaptability in taking on new responsibilities beyond the scope of the defined job description, showcasing a proactive and versatile approach to work.


What We're Looking For


Preferably, a Bachelors in Computer Science, IT, Management or related field.
Detail oriented and organized, with a growth mindset.
Thinks, designs and executes keeping customers at the center of the solution.
Interested in learning about the annotation landscape and application of AI/ML in the trucking industry.
Ability to work collaboratively, in a 24/7/365 set up, with strong context in between them.
The position requires working day, evening and overnight shifts and weekends, while maintaining a standard five-day work week overall.
Good communication skills, oral and written.
Ability to work on multiple projects and tools, and switch context in between them.

description:
About the job

Responsibilities

Team Introduction

CapCut, a ByteDance product, is a leading all-in-one video editing platform empowering creators worldwide. We’re expanding our vibrant LATAM community and seeking a talented specialist to drive content excellence and creator growth in this dynamic region.

CapCut Template is a feature that allows users to create videos quickly and easily by applying pre-designed editing formats. Users simply insert their own media to generate a customized final video.

These Templates Serve Different Types Of Users


 Content creators who professionally use social platforms and rely on templates to scale production and engage with trends.
 Professional videomakers, editors, and small businesses looking for practical, high-quality solutions for promotion and communication.
 Casual social media users who want to participate in trends or create fun videos without needing editing skills.



As a Content & Creator Operations Specialist, you will fuel CapCut’s growth in LATAM by scaling high-quality content, nurturing creators, and enhancing our content ecosystem. You’ll bridge data-driven insights, cultural trends, and creator empowerment to boost user engagement and platform revenue.

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early. Successful candidates must be able to commit to at least 6 months long internship period.

Key Responsibilities


 Drive Content Growth: Increase content volume and quality across LATAM to accelerate user acquisition and revenue.
 End-to-End Content Operations:
 Identify content opportunities through app analytics, social media trends, and cultural insights.
 Curate and customize content strategies for target audiences using localized content elements.
 Manage content production cycles, collaborating with CapCut template creators on calibration.
 Plan in-app campaigns and cross-platform activities to amplify content reach and influence.
 Strengthen Creator Ecosystem:
 Recruit high-quality creators aligned with platform needs and regional content trends.
 Build distinguishing advantages through strategic creator partnerships.
 Creator Empowerment & Management:
 Diagnose creator pain points and skill gaps; deliver training on content strategy/editing.
 Design incentive policies and community guidelines to motivate and manage creators.



Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:


 Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree.
 Fluent in Spanish; professional English proficiency (working language).
 Deep familiarity with LATAM social media and cultural trends; strong content sensitivity: ability to identify viral trends and emerging creators.
 Knowledge of short-video platforms and/or AI tools; basic video editing skills.
 Able to intern for 6-12 months.
 Strong logical thinking and problem-solving with data-driven mindset: ability to translate metrics into actionable strategies., and cross-cultural communication.
 Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and resilient in fast-paced, global team environments.



Preferred Qualifications


 Experience operating social media accounts (personal or professional) is a strong plus.
 Proficiency with mobile/desktop editing tools (e.g., CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut) or AI tools is preferred.



Job Information

About CapCut

CapCut is an all-in-one video editing app that empowers creators to express themselves and transform videos into creative masterpieces. In addition to its basic features, such as video editing, text, stickers, filters, colors and music, CapCut offers free advanced features, including keyframe animation, smooth slow-motion effects, chroma key, Picture-in-Picture (PIP), and stabilization to help you capture and snip moments.

Why Join ByteDance

Inspiring creativity is at the core of ByteDance's mission. Our innovative products are built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and enrich life - a mission we work towards every day.

As ByteDancers, we strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our Company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

ByteDance is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At ByteDance, our mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

Reasonable Accommodation

ByteDance is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

About the job

Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Product Owner, you will set priorities for the squad and groom the Product Backlog to ensure the most valuable and time-critical items are at the top. You will interact with the Iteration Manager/Scrum Master, Development Team, and Client to understand the product and translate it into priorities for the squad.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include


 Prioritize Product Backlog: Place the most valuable and time-critical items at the top of the backlog to ensure the squad is working on the most important tasks.
 Collaborate with Stakeholders: Interact with the Iteration Manager/Scrum Master, Development Team, and Client to understand their needs and expectations.
 Translate Client Needs: Understand the product and client requirements and translate them into priorities for the squad to ensure effective solution delivery.

 Communicate Priorities: Clearly communicate priorities to the squad and stakeholders to ensure everyone is aligned and working towards the same goals.


Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

The Agile Technical Product Owner (Advisor) is accountable for maximizing business value and technical health across one or more technology products within an Agile Release Train (ART). Serving as the internal voice of the customer, this role bridges business strategy and agile delivery by translating enterprise and portfolio objectives into prioritized features and stories. The Advisor partners closely with business stakeholders, Product Managers, architects, and engineering teams to ensure secure, compliant, and sustainable delivery of high quality outcomes aligned to the enterprise roadmap.

This role requires strong technical acumen, agile delivery expertise, and the ability to operate effectively across complex, cross functional, and enterprise scale environments while providing guidance and thought leadership on complex initiatives.

Product Ownership & Value Delivery

 Identify, manage, and escalate risks and cross team dependencies as needed
 Leverage agile tools (e.g., Jira) and metrics to manage flow, throughput, and backlog health


Stakeholder & Cross Functional Collaboration


 Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and delivery teams
 Communicate product direction, trade offs, progress, and risks clearly and effectively
 Maintain awareness of portfolio level initiatives to proactively manage alignment and dependencies
 Provide advisory guidance and recommendations to leadership on complex or high impact initiatives

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Global Business Services’ (GBS) Business Practices team establishes and manages policies and processes for the GTM motion, including deal policy, approval and revenue contracting processes, and other deal related operations (e.g. misbilling, deal support models, etc). The team's reach is widespread across Stripe, not exclusive to one sales segment or geographical region; GBS drives change across go-to-market, positively impacting Stripe users, and cross-functional teams. GBS’s priorities are set through the direction of Stripe leadership and executive vision, partnership with sales and cross-functional organizations. This role sits within Global Business Practices’ Business Practices team, responsible for establishing, managing, and improving policies and processes to improve deal quality and velocity for Stripe.

What you’ll do

Our Business Practices Program Managers are focused on solving GTM’s deal lifecycle challenges to create scalable and efficient deal policies and processes in support of commercial activities. We are looking for a strong program manager who can independently own clearly-scoped workstreams, collaborate effectively across teams, and is building toward progressively larger program responsibility. The ideal candidate will: (1) have deal policy or process experience in a technology or GTM environment, (2) have strong communication skills to work collaboratively across functions, and (3) be comfortable working independently while partnering with management at key decision points.

Responsibilities


Own and drive discrete deal lifecycle program workstreams end-to-end, coordinating cross-functional support needed to deliver projects on time and within scope
Maintain and improve internal GBS program documentation, ensuring methodologies, processes, and operational playbooks are accurate, accessible, and continuously updated to support team knowledge and continuity. 
Structure and execute a repeatable communications process for the GBS team, ensuring consistent, timely, and audience-appropriate messaging across internal stakeholders.
Support change management activities including stakeholder engagement, engaging champions, messaging and communication planning, and enablement delivery
Develop strong collaborative relationships with key stakeholders across Stripe across levels and functions
Prioritize among various projects and synthesize data to guide/support strategy and decision, with manager input
Prepare data-driven analyses and briefs to support senior stakeholder recommendations and decisions



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


2–3 years of experience in program management, business operations, deal operations, or a related discipline
Demonstrated ability to independently apply AI tools to core job responsibilities, proactively identify opportunities to improve workflows using AI, and support teammates in adopting AI-driven processes.
Works well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility in a fast paced, rapidly changing environment
The ability to diagnose, simplify and structure problems and solutions while having command of “the details”
Enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality 
Strong analytical, presentation, and communication skills; comfortable working with cross-functional stakeholders and presenting data-driven insights and recommendations.
Comfort with Excel and/or Google Sheet for analyzing large datasets
Prior experience with Salesforce, CPQ, Deal Approval, Contract Lifecycle Management tools



Preferred Qualifications


Comfort operating with incomplete data and adapting / re-prioritizing activities as business needs change
Deep problem solving and analysis experience (solving business problems - commercial, operational, financial) in a sales-oriented environment
A growth mindset and innate curiosity where every interaction is an opportunity to learn and improve (yourself, and those around you)
You demonstrate leadership qualities throughout your work – taking ownership of challenges, selflessly supporting your colleagues, and setting the standard for quality in your deliverables
Prior experience with payments and/or SaaS 



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

title: Analista de Customer Journey y Experiencia Mexico
skills: Análisis de Datos y Comportamiento de los públicos
Desarrollo de Estrategias y Herramientas de Venta:
Soporte al equipo comercial
description:
About the job

SOMOS LIDERAZGO CON CONCIENCIA

En Natura, tenemos el potencial de impulsar transformaciones significativas. Esto es posible a través de los productos innovadores de Natura y Avon; las experiencias memorables de los servicios de belleza de Bluma y nuestra plataforma de educación financiera, Emana Pay. Marcas y servicios relevantes para quienes los utilizan y reconocidos por nuestro compromiso con la conducción de negocios regenerativos.

Ocupación

Permanente

¿Qué harás aquí?

Responsable de acompañar toda la experiencia de la Fuerza de Venta: Líderes, Gerentes de negocio y Gerentes de ventas de Natura, comprender mejor sus necesidades utilizando diferentes fuentes de investigación: encuestas, focus group, salidas a campo, etc. y utilizar estos datos para optimizar los procesos y actuar como un puente entre el equipo de ventas y todas las áreas de interfase.

¿Qué conocimientos y experiencias necesitarás traer para compartir con nuestra red?


 Análisis de Datos y Comportamiento de los públicos


Mapeo de la Jornada de los públicos de la Fuerza de ventas (Líder de negocio, gerente de negocio y gerente de ventas) identificando los puntos de contacto clave y las áreas de oportunidad para mejorar la experiencia del cliente.

Generar insights: Detectar insights de los datos obtenidos de diversas fuentes (CRM, encuestas, interacciones, visitas a campo, focus group, etc.) para entender el comportamiento, las necesidades y preferencias de los públicos en cada etapa de su Jornada.

Gestión de performance (KPIs).


Desarrollo de Estrategias y Herramientas de Venta:


Optimización de Procesos: Identificar y optimizar los procesos de venta para mejorar la eficiencia del equipo y la experiencia del cliente.

Desarrollo de Contenido: Colaborar en la creación de contenido relevante y personalizado para cada etapa de la jornada del cliente.

Selección de Herramientas: Evaluar y seleccionar herramientas de ventas (automatización de procesos) que faciliten la gestión de clientes y el seguimiento de la jornada.

Responsable de la etapa de crecimiento y retención de la jornada de la Fuerza de ventas (líder de negocios/Gerente de negocios y Gerente de Ventas).

Comunicación: Colaborar con la creación del plan de comunicación, contenido y materiales de nuevas herramientas de gestión, lanzamientos, comunicaciones de impacto a los públicos y sustentación.


 Soporte al equipo comercial


Brindar información al equipo de ventas sobre el uso de herramientas, nuevas estrategias y la importancia de la jornada del cliente. Sustentación del modelo

de negocio.

Crear informes y dashboards que permitan al equipo de ventas visualizar el progreso de los clientes en su jornada y tomar decisiones informadas. Gestión y evolución de las herramientas de performance.

Mantenerse actualizado sobre las últimas tendencias en ventas, marketing y comportamiento del consumidor.

Analizar los resultados de las estrategias implementadas y realizar ajustes para mejorar la eficacia del equipo de ventas y la experiencia del cliente.

Comportamiento de los pú

¿Qué encontrarás aquí?

Somos más que un lugar de trabajo: construimos y vivimos diariamente el Ecosistema Bien Estar Bien, basado en la relación armoniosa entre cada individuo, las relaciones a su alrededor y el entorno en el que está inmerso. Además de ofrecer beneficios enfocados en el bienestar social, físico, financiero, mental y emocional, promovemos un ambiente de prosperidad, pertenencia y propósito, fortaleciendo una red sólida de apoyo, expansión de la conciencia y respeto por la diversidad, equidad e inclusión.

Somos un movimiento que transforma la forma de vivir y hacer negocios en 14 países de América Latina, siempre guiados por la conciencia.

¿Conoces a alguien en Natura?

Si es así, solicita el correo corporativo de esa persona y, al postularte a una vacante, utilízalo para solicitar una recomendación. ¡Es una excelente oportunidad para fortalecer tu red de contactos y avanzar en tu proceso de selección con nosotros!

Natura celebra y abraza la diversidad en todas sus formas y pluralidades.

Invitamos a #Mujeres, #PersonasNegras, #PersonasConDiscapacidad, personas de la comunidad #LGBTQIA+, #MujeresEmbarazadas y personas con #50años+ a postularse para esta vacante.
